correctness.rationale: Choose x in any normalized real slice S with ||x||=1. By real ADP, sup_{y in S}max_{sign}||ix+sign y||=2. Both norms are <=||ix+sign x||+||y-x||<=sqrt(2)+diam(S). The equalities ||(i+sign)x||=sqrt(2) follow from complex homogeneity. Thus diam(S)>=2-sqrt(2) for every S. Qualitative nondentability follows. No limit/interchange or numerical computation is required.

value.rationale: The infimal slice diameter is a natural geometric invariant. Even though ordinary real ADP allows dentable/RNP examples, the distinct realifications of complex spaces require a dimension-free, strictly positive universal lower bound. The quantitative conclusion refines qualitative obstructions and gives a precise structural restriction of the 2026 constructed class; the bound need not be sharp.
